title.ko: 추상명사 연어: raise concerns · pose a threat · draw a conclusion · bear in mind
title.en: abstract noun collocations: raise concerns, pose a threat, draw a conclusion, bear in mind

explain.ko: 연어(collocation)는 자연스럽게 함께 쓰이는 단어 조합입니다. 추상명사는 특정 동사와 짝을 이루는 경우가 많습니다. raise concerns, pose a threat, draw a conclusion, bear in mind, strike a balance, spark controversy, exert influence 등이 대표적입니다. 이 조합은 의미가 비슷한 다른 동사로 바꾸면 어색해지므로(make a conclusion은 틀림) 덩어리째 외워야 합니다. 학술 글과 토론에서 어휘의 자연스러움을 높여 줍니다.
explain.en: Collocations are word combinations that occur naturally. Abstract nouns often pair with particular verbs: raise concerns, pose a threat, draw a conclusion, bear in mind, strike a balance, spark controversy, exert influence. Swapping in a similar verb can sound wrong (make a conclusion is incorrect), so learn them as chunks. They make vocabulary sound natural in academic writing and debate.

head: 동사 / Verb

notes.ko: make a conclusion, do a decision 같은 오류에 주의하세요: draw/reach a conclusion, make a decision.
notes.en: Avoid errors like make a conclusion and do a decision: draw/reach a conclusion, make a decision.

notes.ko: 연어는 덩어리로 암기하고 예문과 함께 기억하세요.
notes.en: Learn collocations as chunks with example sentences.

notes.ko: 사전의 연어 정보를 활용하면 자연스러운 조합을 확인할 수 있습니다.
notes.en: A collocations dictionary helps you check natural pairings.

prompt.en: Write 4 sentences giving your position on a social issue using abstract noun collocations.

task.model: Concerns have been raised that artificial intelligence could pose a threat to jobs. But the benefits this technology could bring must also be borne in mind. Governments should seek policies that strike a balance between innovation and safety. This decision will have far-reaching implications for society as a whole.

model_trans.ko: 인공지능 기술은 일자리에 위협이 될 수 있다는 우려가 제기되고 있습니다. 하지만 이 기술이 가져올 이점도 염두에 두어야 합니다. 정부는 혁신과 안전 사이에서 균형을 맞추는 정책을 모색해야 합니다. 이 결정은 앞으로 사회 전반에 중대한 영향을 미칠 것입니다.
model_trans.en: Concerns have been raised that artificial intelligence could pose a threat to jobs. But the benefits this technology could bring must also be borne in mind. Governments should seek policies that strike a balance between innovation and safety. This decision will have far-reaching implications for society as a whole.
